verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a PR-review automation that watches for a configurable label, inspects full PR context, and posts an AI review comment once per label event, which directly matches the story's intent. However, this is label-triggered rather than automatic on every PR, and there's no evidence of inline (line-level) comments specifically or independent/hands-on confirmation of review quality. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic (non-label-gated) triggering on every PR, confirmation comments are inline/line-specific rather than a single summary comment, and independent verification of the feature working in practice.
